=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text pal " .:-=+*%"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 0
put b 0 c
emit b
end
note IEEE f64: one rounding per operator and no fused multiply-add (OMEGESE 9.9), so an
note independent reference in any IEEE-754 binary64 language reproduces every character
fn main to int
for r ulong 24
ci = sub 1.15 mul f64 r 0.1
for c ulong 72
cr = sub mul f64 c 0.0375 2.2
zr = f64 0.0
zi = f64 0.0
it = ulong 0
while lt it 50 bound 50
zr2 = mul zr zr
zi2 = mul zi zi
if gt add zr2 zi2 4.0
break
end
zi = add mul mul 2.0 zr zi ci
zr = add sub zr2 zi2 cr
it = add it 1
end
if eq it 50
emitc 35
else
emitc get pal rem it 8
end
end
emit nl
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
